description: Base: E060 code, which is the E057 tip (static shapes, max(dim).values pool, Muon floor 0.05) plus E060's vectorized dirac init and fused fp16 normalization in prepare. Both prepare changes are math-neutral, so the result still belongs to the pooled family, which E060 brings to 8 runs with a mean of 0.7531. Change only the head's Muon learning rate: set it to 0.5x the filter Muon LR (0.12 peak, same schedule shape and floor) as its own 0-d GPU tensor, so nothing recompiles. Leave everything else unchanged. Score it twice. Instrumentation only: log the submission source hash and a per-seed checksum of the final weights and BN buffers (for H4.4.1).
